title: Reconcile the bounded legacy capability backlog with accepted capability identities
description:
Build the migration bridge from legacy magic-item executionReadiness/engine:F backlog to
the positive capability contract. The result is a bounded backlog/candidate view, not
authority for all source mechanics. Do not couple audit-finding registry membership to
capability-universe membership.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every migrated legacy backlog entry has stable identity/source linkage sufficient to decide whether it is a positive capability candidate.
- Selected capabilities use the accepted capability identity/contract; unselected entries remain explicit backlog.
- The inventory does not infer source-negative absence or corpus completeness.
- Finding-registry membership is not authority for capability-universe membership.
- Evidence fields state their exact claim strength under Foundation 4.
notes:
